title: TD 100 experiment on a woman on film
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of TD 100 experiment on a woman on film, about early 1960s at Intelectron, New York City, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi says there is silent film from the early 1960s, shot at Intelectron, a company in New York City, showing an experiment on a woman sitting behind a wall in another room. He says the experimenters use a device their inventor built at the time, called the TD 100, and that without any sound it is obvious what is happening. If true, it would show such a device being tested on a person through a wall decades ago.
